title: Hello (admission request)
description: Sent by the Soul entry point over the hq/v1 control socket at clock-in. Source: Soul Agent Platform draft 0.4, Section 5 and Appendix A. HQ rejects an unaccepted definition (definition_not_accepted), an unsupported profile (profile_insufficient), an unsupported version (unsupported_version), and a prior epoch older than its own record on a move (stale_epoch).

request_id.description: Unique per request; a repeat with identical content returns the prior result.

definition_digest.description: Digest of the accepted definition revision; not an identity or a token.

prior_installation_epoch.description: Present only on a move; the epoch of the installation being replaced.

supported_versions.description: Every major version of each contract the entry point speaks; HQ picks N or N-1 (R7, T14).

supported_capabilities.description: Versioned capability tokens the entry point supports, e.g. sealed-inner-v1. Unknown required capabilities fail closed (R7).

requested_profile.description: Profile the Soul asks for; HQ may grant a weaker one and must say so (R8).

role.description: Role name from SoulInfo.json; exactly one 'lead'.

adapter_id.description: Adapter package id from the qualified-adapter catalog. The schema names no vendor; fixtures use neutral ids (R10).

adapter_version.description: Pinned exact version (R12); eval cells are keyed on it (Section 10).

requested_roles.description: Exactly one lead; specialists as declared in SoulInfo.json.
